Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Record Class VisibleEntity

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ke.ric.renderer.api.VisibleEntity
Record Components:
uuid - stable captured entity UUID
objectId - nonzero native object identity within this render result
type - nonblank namespaced entity type, such as minecraft:player
name - captured display label, which may be null
visiblePixels - number of image pixels whose primary ray is owned by this entity
public record VisibleEntity(UUID uuid, int objectId, String type, String name, int visiblePixels) extends Record
Immutable identity and primary-ray pixel coverage of an entity in a rendered image. This describes captured evidence, not a live Bukkit entity. Transparent contributors that do not own the primary ray are not counted; names are labels and never identity keys.

    • player

      public boolean player()

    • coverage

      public double coverage(int totalPixels)
      Returns this entity's fraction of all native-pass image pixels. This is not reconstructed from a display name or from final composited colours.
      Parameters:
      totalPixels - positive width×height for the corresponding render result
      Returns:
      primary-ray coverage in 0..1
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if totalPixels is not positive or smaller than visiblePixels

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
